note: THE single source of truth for supported locales, their writing direction, and how a request's locale is resolved. Hand-maintained — this is product policy. `pnpm ds:i18n` generates the locale types, the message types, and the per-language font binding from it, and validates that every locale's message catalogue is complete.

ar.name: Arabic
ar.note: numberingSystem 'latn' shows Western digits, which most Gulf business software expects. Switch to 'arab' for Eastern Arabic numerals if the market wants them — it is a product decision, not a technical one.

de.name: German
de.note: German runs ~30% longer than English. Every component needs a long-content story or German will break fixed-width layouts.

resolution.note: 'path' (/de/settings) | 'cookie' (user preference, no URL change) | 'header' (Accept-Language only). Cookie: the switcher is a client control, not a navigation — no separate route per locale, and the cookie is non-httpOnly so both middleware and the switcher can read/write it. Middleware also forwards the resolved locale on `headerName` for this same request, so a Server Component sees the right locale on the very first paint even before the Set-Cookie reaches the browser. Change this one value and middleware follows.
